verdict.rationale: Grafana documents an active file-based provisioning system for version-controlled dashboards and data sources (GitOps), plus an observability-as-code approach for defining dashboards and configs in code with CI/CD deployment. A terminal CLI suited to CI/CD pipelines and multiple environments supports repeatable provisioning. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that alert rules can be provisioned as code, any mention of Terraform or JSON dashboard models, clear documentation of a provisioning API (the OpenAPI probe is only a site-level spec), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
